Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:59487
Court No. - 14
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 10759 of 2023
Applicant :- Rashid Alias Shahrukh
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy.
Home Govt. Civil Sectt. Lko

Counsel for Applicant :- Himanshu Shukla,Lalit Kishore Tiwari
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Raghvendra Singh,Sachin Kumar Mishra
Hon'ble Mohd. Faiz Alam Khan,J.
1.
Counter affidavit filed by the State is taken on record.

2. Heard Shri Himanshu Shukla, learned counsel for the accused-applicant as well as learned A.G.A.
for the State, Shri Sachin Kumar Mishra, learned counsel appearing for the complainant/informant and perused the record.
3.

This bail application has been moved by the accused/applicant- Rashid Alias Shahrukh for grant of bail, in Case Crime No.155 of 2023, under Sections 366, 504, 506, 376 I.P.C., Police Station Biswan, District Sitapur, during trial.

4. Learned counsel for the accused-applicant while pressing the bail application submits that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and he has not committed any offence as claimed by the prosecution.

sentences.text: It is further submitted that F.I.R. of this case has been lodged by the mother of the victim on 09.04.2023 at Police Station Biswan, Sitapur alleging therein that applicant has enticed away the daughter of the informant aged about 19 years on 31.03.2023.

While drawing attention of this Court towards the statement of the victim recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., it is vehemently submitted that in the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she had not alleged any allegation against the applicant and in fact even has not taken the name of the applicant while in her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she has stated that on 31.03.2023 the applicant had informed her that he is leaving home and she has also accompanied him and they had gone to Delhi.

The applicant was known to her for the last two years and they were in love with each other, however, their family members were not ready to accept their relationship and they started living as husband and wife at Delhi.
She claimed herself to be educated till Class-7th.

6. It is vehemently submitted that as per radiological process, the age of the prosecutrix has been assessed as 18 years and as per educational credential, her age is coming at the date and time of the incident as 19 years thus she was major and since she was a consenting party, no offence in fact has been committed by the applicant.

It is also submitted that after recording the statement of the prosecutrix under Section 164 Cr.P.C., an application appears to have been moved by the prosecutrix before the Superintendent of Police, Sitapur alleging that her statement under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C. has been given on the assurance of the applicant that he will solemnize marriage with the prosecutrix while he is now not ready to marry the prosecutrix and it is also alleged in the application that sexual assault was committed by the applicant on her.
7.

It is also submitted that in view of the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., her application given subsequently to the Superintendent of Police and allegations levelled therein are not material.

It is further submitted that initially the prosecutrix refused to undergo any medical examination, however, subsequently on 12.06.2023, she was subjected to medical examination, however, no abnormality or any injury of any kind was noticed on her person and there is no evidence with regard to commission of sexual assault.

It is next submitted that applicant is in jail in this case since 04.08.2023 and he is not having any criminal history, charge-sheet in this case has already been submitted and there is no apprehension that after being released on bail the applicant may flee from the course of law or may otherwise misuse the liberty.
8.

Learned A.G.A., however, opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that the applicant has committed an heinous offence and having regard to the material/evidence available against the applicant, he is not entitled to be released on bail, but could not controvert the other factual submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant.

9. Shri Sachin Kumar Mishra, learned counsel appearing for the complainant/informant vehemently opposes the prayer of bail of the applicant on the ground that the applicant has committed heinous offence, therefore, he is not entitled to be released on bail.
10. Having heard learned counsel for the parties and having perused the record, it is evident that the prosecutrix/victim of the incident was major at the date and time of the incident.

In the statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., she has not levelled any allegation Rashid Alias Shahrukh vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67294588/
2 against the applicant and she claimed herself to be in love with him and had left home with her free wish and will.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Subsequently she appears to have moved an application before the Superintendent of Police, Sitapur, wherein sexual assault committed by the applicant has been claimed.

Case of the applicant appears to be that no such offence as claimed by the prosecutrix has been committed by the applicant and also that even if the case of the prosecution is taken on its face, the prosecutrix was major at the date and time of the alleged incident and she was a consenting party, thus no offence has been committed by the applicant.
Charge-sheet in this case has already been filed.
Applicant is in jail in this case since 04.08.2023 without any previous criminal history.
The presence of the applicant could be secured before the trial court by placing adequate conditions.

11. Having regard to the overall facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the nature of the offence, evidence, complicity of the accused, severity of punishment, submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, I am of the considered view that applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is thus allowed.

12. Let the accused/applicant- Rashid Alias Shahrukh involved in above-mentioned case, be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
(ii) The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
13. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.
14. Identity, status and residence proof of the applicant and sureties be verified by the Court concerned before the bonds are accepted.
15. Observations made herein-above by this court are only for the purpose of disposal of this bail application and shall not be construed as an expression of this Court on the merits of the case.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023 Anupam S/-
